entityStrategy.businessEntity: one stable Wellmade Water Heater Service entity
entityStrategy.rule: city pages reference the same business entity and never create a fake local office

requirements: verified name, URL, phone, and service vocabulary only
areaServed must not exceed owner-confirmed coverage
FAQ schema must match visible FAQ
do not imply every linked city is a confirmed physical location
Service area names the city but does not claim a local address
provider references the canonical business entity
FAQ JSON-LD exactly matches visible questions and answers

globalRules: visible content and schema claims must match canonical facts
no AggregateRating or Review without verified first-party evidence
no Offer or price fields without approved pricing facts
no openingHours, address, license, award, or same-day guarantee without verified facts
validate rendered JSON-LD because client-side injection cannot be assessed reliably from stripped HTML
